all_text_content:
Verse of the Day
Is not this the fast that I have chosen? to loose the bands of wickedness, to undo the heavy burdens, and to let the oppressed go free, and that ye break every yoke?
Isaiah 58:6
Quote of the Day
"Each of us is ultimately responsible for our decisions, beliefs, and actions, assisted by heavenly and earthly ministering angels."
Elder Gary E. Stevenson | 1 Apr 2026General Conference
